item.title: Choose the Room That Comes Home
item.description: Two invitations reveal a rule for Tom’s attention: be present where presence itself creates value, and write where judgment is the product. Helping coach the boys can deepen family life, while a physician technology invitation can become a bounded one-page decision memo instead of an evening committee role. A 2026 randomized workplace trial supplies a counterweight: selective in-person contact can improve communication and productivity, so the goal is not isolation but better channel choice. The episode addresses the security gate before relying on a workstation from the office, treats a signed file-review agreement as an option to measure before expanding, offers an employment-preserving boundary response, and uses one memory from yesterday’s lunch for relational savoring without adding another family task. Full transcript: https://arthurburtcurry.com/c7cQz082m963h-R6acs0vj5khhcWvUDK/episode-003-transcript.txt

item.title: Buy the Option, Not the Province
item.description: Several work possibilities have become real at once, but a faster licensing path is a reason to wait for demonstrated demand, not a reason to pre-buy another province. This episode builds a one-page expansion gate around actual file volume, total attention cost, regulator requirements, and fixed fees. It also catches two less obvious edges: incorporation can change WorkSafe Personal Coverage eligibility, and Gemini’s privacy treatment differs between Workspace surfaces and personal Connected Apps. The work shield is a next-workday quarantine for non-urgent conflict drafts, with clear exceptions for safety and formal duties. The family move protects one unclaimed, phone-free transition in a Saturday already rich with sport, art, and a match. It favors quiet optionality over speculative administration and stimulation. Full transcript: https://arthurburtcurry.com/c7cQz082m963h-R6acs0vj5khhcWvUDK/episode-002-transcript.txt
